profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Magic Leap

positions.title: Software Engineer on assignment at Google
positions.description:
• Contracted with Google as an XR specialist.
• Implemented features, automated testing, and resolved bugs for Jetpack Compose for XR.
• Primary contributor for follow-modes (aka headlock) feature which was shown in Google I/O.

positions.title: Sr Manager, Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for all public sites of the company including the www site.
• Administered HubSpot website, email campaigns and integrations with Salesforce.
• Managed a team of 9 frontend and backend developers.
• Took lead on support triage, project management, weekly stand ups and defining requirements.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a React MDM website. MDM allows enterprise users to manage their fleet of devices through a web console.
• Quickly adapted to a new technology stack (React, Mac/Linux, Git, Node).

positions.title: Web Tools Integration Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented the company’s first data warehouse and reporting solution. This entailed installation of SQL Server, Tableau, modeling data structures and setting up redundancy.
• Set up ETL integrations with 8 systems. This included Greenhouse, SAP, SuccessFactors, Jira, Jama, Trello and some homegrown systems.
• Created a tool for the industrial design team to capture results of their studies. This included a data capture screen and a search interface where they can perform Boolean searches and click on a 3D human model to filter by body part. (AngularJS, .Net, SQL Server).
• Maintained multiple homegrown and 3rd party tools for the security team. These were used to manage visitors into our offices and track our physical intellectual properties.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Created the flagship SaaS application used by sports organizations to manage their leagues, teams, game schedules, and communications. Implemented with AngularJS.
• Developed API used by the mobile version of our product. Implemented with .Net and SQL Server.

positions.title: Enterprise Architect
positions.description:
• Created and maintained several web-based tools for use by other departments. These were mostly ASP.Net web forms and .Net web services with a SQL Server database.
• Voluntarily created training videos for other developers to ramp up on our enterprise systems.
• Managed offshore dev and QA teams, totaling 15 people. Mentored 4 of them into leadership roles.
• Managed a team of 5 local developers.
• Promoted to Enterprise Architect where I defined APIs to allow for easy integration between systems.
